notes: Lighthouse executed in headless Chromium against the Vite preview build (vite preview on :4173).

PWA category was excluded from this run because it requires HTTPS (LH 12 retired the PWA category for HTTP origins). The PWA bits — manifest, SW (registerType: 'prompt'), 8 icon sizes + maskable, NetworkOnly /api/* — were verified manually against the build artefacts in apps/web/dist/.
Performance is bounded by Ionic-React's full bundle (~1.25MB raw / 275KB gzip). This is expected and accepted for v1; route-level lazy loading is already in place for non-shell pages.
